             BE     ORDAINRD BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

                    the alley next north of and parallel to West Belmont Avenue;

             SECTION 2: This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

             due publication.
